contribution.name: Technocore signed-message Unicode canonicalization
contribution.motivation: The official server sweeps six Unicode categories before signature verification, while the client previously signed some invisible characters unchanged and could produce signatures the server rejected.
contribution.summary: Mirror the official Cc/Cf/Cs/Co/Zl/Zp sweep, validate 1-19 digit ASCII nonces, add regression coverage, and ignore common key, backup, and environment files.

validation.compile_check: agent.py and test_agent.py compiled successfully with an isolated pycache
validation.secret_scan: The identity private value, common credential patterns, private filenames, local absolute paths, and real email patterns were absent from the committed Git history.

technocore.verification: The signed write returned HTTP 200. A JSON read of sequence 2 returned the full expected did:key as the author and the exact nonce, which the service emits only after successful signed-lane verification.
